solutions.java: static int maxProductSubarray(int[]a){int max=a[0],min=a[0],best=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){int x=a[i];if(x<0){int t=max;max=min;min=t;}max=Math.max(x,max*x);min=Math.min(x,min*x);best=Math.max(best,max);}return best;}
solutions.csharp: static int MaxProductSubarray(int[]a){int mx=a[0],mn=a[0],best=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.Length;i++){int x=a[i];if(x<0)(mx,mn)=(mn,mx);mx=Math.Max(x,mx*x);mn=Math.Min(x,mn*x);best=Math.Max(best,mx);}return best;}
solutions.cpp: int maxProductSubarray(const vector<int>&a){int mx=a[0],mn=a[0],best=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.size();i++){int x=a[i];if(x<0)swap(mx,mn);mx=max(x,mx*x);mn=min(x,mn*x);best=max(best,mx);}return best;}

title: Rearrange an array so even numbers are at even indexes
question: Place even values at even indexes and odd values at odd indexes, where possible.

solutions.python:
def rearrange_even_indexes(a):
    out=a.copy(); evens=[x for x in a if x%2==0]; odds=[x for x in a if x%2]
    i=j=0
    for k in range(len(a)):
        if k%2==0 and i<len(evens):out[k]=evens[i];i+=1
        elif k%2==1 and j<len(odds):out[k]=odds[j];j+=1
    return out
solutions.java: static int[] rearrangeEvenIndexes(int[]a){int[]r=new int[a.length];int e=0,o=1;for(int x:a)if(x%2==0){if(e<a.length)r[e]=x;e+=2;}else{if(o<a.length)r[o]=x;o+=2;}return r;}
solutions.csharp: static int[] RearrangeEvenIndexes(int[]a){int[]r=new int[a.Length];int e=0,o=1;foreach(int x in a)if(x%2==0){if(e<a.Length)r[e]=x;e+=2;}else{if(o<a.Length)r[o]=x;o+=2;}return r;}

explanationEnglish: The code keeps separate positions for even indexes and odd indexes. Even values are placed at indexes 0, 2, 4, while odd values are placed at indexes 1, 3, 5.

title: Find elements smaller than the next element and greater than the previous element
question: Find elements that are greater than the element immediately before them and smaller than the element immediately after them.

solutions.python: def middle_values(a): return [a[i] for i in range(1,len(a)-1) if a[i]>a[i-1] and a[i]<a[i+1]]
solutions.java: static List<Integer> middleValues(int[]a){List<Integer>r=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=1;i<a.length-1;i++)if(a[i]>a[i-1]&&a[i]<a[i+1])r.add(a[i]);return r;}
solutions.csharp: static int[] MiddleValues(int[]a){var r=new List<int>();for(int i=1;i<a.Length-1;i++)if(a[i]>a[i-1]&&a[i]<a[i+1])r.Add(a[i]);return r.ToArray();}
solutions.cpp: vector<int> middleValues(const vector<int>&a){vector<int>r;for(int i=1;i+1<a.size();i++)if(a[i]>a[i-1]&&a[i]<a[i+1])r.push_back(a[i]);return r;}

explanationEnglish: The loop ignores the first and last elements because they do not have neighbours on both sides. For every middle element, it compares the value with the previous and next values and keeps it only when both conditions are true.
explanationHindi: Loop first aur last element ko ignore karta hai kyunki unke dono taraf neighbours nahi hote. Har middle element ko previous aur next se compare karke condition match hone par result mein rakhta hai.
howToSolve: For neighbour-comparison problems, start at index 1 and stop before the last index; compare arr[i] with arr[i - 1] and arr[i + 1].

title: Find all subarrays with a given sum
question: Find all subarrays with a given sum

title: Merge two sorted arrays without extra space
question: Merge two sorted arrays without extra space

solutions.java: static void mergeSorted(int[]a,int[]b){int n=a.length,m=b.length,gap=(n+m+1)/2;while(gap>0){int i=0,j=gap;while(j<n+m){int x=i<n?a[i]:b[i-n],y=j<n?a[j]:b[j-n];if(x>y){if(i<n&&j<n){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}else if(i<n){int t=a[i];a[i]=b[j-n];b[j-n]=t;}else{int t=b[i-n];b[i-n]=b[j-n];b[j-n]=t;}}i++;j++;}if(gap==1)break;gap=(gap+1)/2;}}
solutions.csharp: static void MergeSorted(int[]a,int[]b){int n=a.Length,m=b.Length,gap=(n+m+1)/2;while(gap>0){int i=0,j=gap;while(j<n+m){int x=i<n?a[i]:b[i-n],y=j<n?a[j]:b[j-n];if(x>y){if(i<n&&j<n)(a[i],a[j])=(a[j],a[i]);else if(i<n)(a[i],b[j-n])=(b[j-n],a[i]);else (b[i-n],b[j-n])=(b[j-n],b[i-n]);}i++;j++;}if(gap==1)break;gap=(gap+1)/2;}}
solutions.cpp: void mergeSorted(vector<int>&a,vector<int>&b){int n=a.size(),m=b.size(),gap=(n+m+1)/2;while(gap>0){int i=0,j=gap;while(j<n+m){int &x=(i<n?a[i]:b[i-n]),&y=(j<n?a[j]:b[j-n]);if(x>y)swap(x,y);i++;j++;}if(gap==1)break;gap=(gap+1)/2;}}

explanationEnglish: Two sorted arrays are combined by comparing their current elements and moving the smaller one into the correct position. This keeps the overall order sorted.
explanationHindi: Do sorted arrays ke current elements compare karke chhota element sahi position par rakhte hain. Isse final array sorted rehta hai.
howToSolve: For merging sorted arrays, use two pointers, compare the current values, move the smaller one, and then append any remaining values.
